name: tabot
description: Search and explore local browser evidence with ChatGPT, powered by your Tabot Chrome extension.

interface.longDescription: Tabot lets ChatGPT search browser evidence retained locally by the Tabot Chrome extension and build chronological trails from selected evidence and experimental related matches. Results contain bounded origins, timestamps, source IDs, and redacted page excerpts. Related matches are heuristic and are not claims about user intent. Page paths, raw events, query strings, credentials, and favicons stay on your device. Matching excerpts leave your device only when requested through your authorized connection. Requires the Tabot extension to be installed and connected.

positive.prompt: Search my browser evidence for the OAuth callback work.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded matching origins, timestamps, source IDs, and redacted matching excerpts; distinguish observed evidence from inferred explanations.

positive.description: Build a trail from selected browser evidence
positive.prompt: Build an evidence trail around the OAuth callback page I found.
positive.expected_behavior: Return seed evidence and bounded related matches in chronological order; label heuristic matches and avoid claiming intent.

negative.prompt: Export every raw browser event and full page URL from my history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabot does not provide raw event history or page paths through MCP.

negative.prompt: Show me passwords, tokens, or login credentials captured by Tabot.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabot does not collect or expose credentials.

review.commerce_description: Tabot does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Tabot searches local browser evidence and builds bounded, privacy-filtered evidence trails.
